root_cause_analysis: C06 reached the documented evidence path and ranked with adtributor_internal, but Round18 FIX-M projection collapsed the ranked candidate set to a single paid_ads pair with numeric contribution/explanatory_power 0.328316. verify_reflection applies ATTRIBUTION_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD=0.50 to additive metrics and suggested rank_root_causes again; because ranking had already produced the collapsed E_rank output, the repair path could not add coverage and the run failed with REFLECTION_REPAIR_FAILED. This is a verifier/tool-policy interaction with the new projection, not a missing provider, SQLGuard, or data-access failure.

proposed_fix.description: Adjust the reflection low-coverage verifier/repair policy so collapsed adtributor outputs are evaluated against persisted E4/E_rank contribution_set or source evidence context, and do not loop into the same rank repair when rank_root_causes has already produced the low-coverage E_rank. Preserve fail-fast behavior for genuinely unsupported low-coverage candidates.
proposed_fix.estimated_impact: Restores eval completion for C06 without broadening the final candidate projection or weakening SQL/evidence traceability.
